query:
SELECT
                    jobs.id,
                    jobs.deal_id,
                    jobs.run_id,
                    jobs.piece_index,
                    jobs.piece_cid,
                    jobs.bms_job_id,
                    jobs.url_tested,
                    jobs.routing_key,
                    jobs.worker_count,
                    jobs.status,
                    jobs.ping_avg_ms,
                    jobs.head_avg_ms,
                    jobs.ttfb_ms,
                    jobs.download_speed_mbps,
                    jobs.error_message,
                    jobs.created_at,
                    jobs.completed_at
               FROM
                    UNNEST($2::uuid[]) AS requested(run_id)
               CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT
                        id,
                        deal_id,
                        run_id,
                        piece_index,
                        piece_cid,
                        bms_job_id,
                        url_tested,
                        routing_key,
                        worker_count,
                        status,
                        ping_avg_ms,
                        head_avg_ms,
                        ttfb_ms,
                        download_speed_mbps,
                        error_message,
                        created_at,
                        completed_at
                    FROM
                        deal_sli_bms_jobs
                    WHERE
                        deal_id = $1
                        AND run_id = requested.run_id
                    ORDER BY
                        created_at DESC,
                        id DESC
                    LIMIT $3
               ) jobs
               ORDER BY
                    jobs.run_id,
                    jobs.created_at DESC,
                    jobs.id DESC
